reviewer: Primary agent personally inspected native unrotated close and wide point crosshairs, then actual rasters and modern vectors, all listed figures.

findings.black-pine: Pine new-check position improves over eight controls but western Black Brook remains displaced north, more so after Mary Ann addition; do not promote either experiment as replacement.
findings.mary-ann-black-cove: Eleven controls align the fitted Mary Ann confluence; Black Brook mouth remains 481 m off and southwestern tributary 227 m off. Coast and unfitted stream geometry remain inconsistent.
findings.warren: Lake controls align locally; north/west drainage and tributaries remain displaced.
findings.ingonish-island: Fitted northern tip local; full perimeter and neighbouring coastal detail not accepted; southern V02 remains diagnostic.
findings.clyburn-middle: Some local channel improvement; meanders and Middle Head coastline differ. Connected mainland identity alone cannot select equivalent historical/modern extremity.
findings.freshwater-smoky: Harbour and southern drainage remain displaced; cape tip fit does not validate adjoining coast.
findings.full-sheet: Eastern sea, legend, Ingonish Island, offshore rocks and full mapped frame preserved in both rasters.
findings.02-seam: Northern drainage and coastline not continuous; eastern sea-only window cannot establish geographic acceptance.
findings.05-seam: Western Black Brook and adjoining drainage visibly mismatched; southern Cameron/Clyburn seam also unaccepted.
findings.07-seam: Southern drainage and coastal seam unaccepted; sea-only window supplies no physical check.
findings.browser: Both exact raster hashes persisted in IndexedDB through desktop/mobile reload; rendered raster visible, no console errors.
